bio.text: Mary Silva, a Republican, advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary for Washington's 1st Congressional District and will face Democratic incumbent Suzan DelBene in the November general election.
HeraldNet reported in July 2026 that Silva, then 46, is an audiologist who lives in Everett.
